svg.aria-label: AgentRQ message send delay: you type 'deploy to prod' and send it, and it waits in the thread with a 5 second countdown and Cancel and Send Now buttons while codex has not seen it yet. At 3 you click Cancel and the text comes back to the composer; you change it to 'deploy to staging', send it, and click Send Now, so codex gets it, deploys, and the agents celebrate.

svg.text: Messages wait before the agent sees them.
